candidates.simpler_approach: Use git -C or an explicit command working directory.
candidates.potential_value: Avoid one location-related retry in a fresh-checkout workflow.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: One later natural fresh-checkout command using the explicit path.
candidates.cost: Low, but the family is parked and excluded; no renamed variant is eligible.

pre_result_plan.real_task: Determine whether the existing pytest #14777 conversation contains a new external reply that changes the next action.
pre_result_plan.observed_problem: The repository says to return to the thread if an external response appears, but the current conversation state had not been checked in this session.
pre_result_plan.baseline: The tracked state is WAITING_EXTERNAL_RESPONSE and authorizes no further pytest work.
pre_result_plan.hypothesis: A current conversation read either finds at least one non-owner reply and supplies a concrete new decision input, or falsifies the need for action today.
pre_result_plan.minimum_useful_effect: At least one new non-owner reply with information that changes the next action.
pre_result_plan.quality_control: Use the canonical pytest-dev/pytest #14777 conversation; distinguish the owner's disclosed comment from external replies; do not infer a reply from PR metadata or search snippets.
pre_result_plan.overhead: Count startup reading, gate and branch audits, connector discovery/read, reporting, verification, checkpoint maintenance and publication.
pre_result_plan.stop_condition: If the only comment is the owner's existing comment, record an inconclusive observation and stop: no poller, reproduction, patch, comment or new external task.

result.finding: The current connector read returned only the previously disclosed Robakk84 comment. No external reply exists in the returned conversation, so the stop condition fired and the next action did not change.

decision_reason: Reject a monitor or further pytest work from this observation. Keep the thread outside active WIP and revisit only after an externally visible reply provides new evidence.
failures: The first publication attempt used update_ref for a branch that did not yet exist and GitHub returned HTTP 422. No ref changed. The dedicated create_branch operation then created the feature ref at the already verified remote commit.
limitations: One read-only snapshot and one conversation. Absence of a reply is not utility evidence, does not prove future silence and does not establish agent or LLM improvement.
